summary: Check the local OneDev and Validator publication scope

delivery.outcome: wellman reads, validates and reports the new-project.local-ci-publication/v1 scope (absent = every repository) and offers an additive writer of the unrestricted default for adoption.
nonGoals: Wire the writer into wellman adopt (dependent integration ticket)

architecture.decision: A dependency-free local_ci module mirrors the new-project schema; ConformanceRunner.run_all reports an invalid scope file as a WARNING while the unrestricted default applies.
interfaceChanges: wellman check reports GOV-LOCAL-CI-001 for an invalid .governance/local-ci-publication.json
architecture.rollback: Revert the commit; the policy file is optional and absence keeps the default.

validation.evidence: Absent policy applies everywhere; restriction narrows; invalid documents rejected.
